#### `def _normalize_timezone_dtypes(df)` (Línea 286)
- **Propósito:** PyArrow uses pytz by default for timezones, but pandas uses
zoneinfo / datetime.timezone since pandas 3.0.

TODO: Starting with pyarrow 25, it will use zoneinfo by default, and then
this normalization can be skipped (https://github.com/apache/arrow/pull/49694).
- **Firma:** `def _normalize_timezone_dtypes(df)`
- **Retorno / Efectos:** Consulta código fuente.
